idea-plugin.name: Gradle Task Graph Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Tool window that visualizes the real dependsOn graph between Gradle tasks in your project -- root project plus every submodule declared in settings.gradle(.kts) -- grouped into dependency layers, with any real cycle called out in its own top section, in red.

Recognizes both DSLs: Kotlin (tasks.register("x") { dependsOn("y") }, val x by tasks.registering) and Groovy (task x(dependsOn: y), x.dependsOn y).

100% static text analysis of your build files -- never a real Gradle evaluation or daemon. Stated honestly: v0.1 only sees explicit dependsOn declarations written in your build scripts, not the many implicit task orderings a plugin like java/application wires up internally -- a real, documented limitation, not a bug.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
